title: Indian Contract Act, 1872 — Section 57 (Reciprocal promise to do things legal, and also other things illegal)

content.overview: Section 57 provides that where persons reciprocally promise, firstly, to do certain things which are legal, and, secondly, under specified circumstances, to do certain other things which are illegal, the first set of promises is a contract, but the second is a void agreement.
content.glance: Reciprocal promises partly legal, partly illegal → legal set is a contract; illegal set is a void agreement.
content.study: Where reciprocal promises include a legal set and, under specified circumstances, an illegal set, the legal set is a contract and the illegal set is a void agreement. Current-law framing: separate the legal and illegal sets; enforce the legal set as a contract; treat the illegal set as void under s. 57.

sections.heading: Legal set
sections.body: First set of promises (legal) is a contract.

sections.heading: Illegal set
sections.body: Second set (illegal under specified circumstances) is a void agreement.

provisions.title: Reciprocal promise to do things legal, and also other things illegal

examples.title: Mixed legal and illegal
examples.body: A and B reciprocally promise to sell a house (legal) and, if certain conditions arise, to use it as a gambling house (illegal). The sale promise is a contract; the gambling promise is void under s. 57.

hypotheticals.question: Does the illegal part void the entire reciprocal arrangement?
hypotheticals.analysis: No. Section 57: the legal set is a contract; only the illegal set is a void agreement.

misconceptions.trap: Any illegal element voids all reciprocal promises.
misconceptions.correction: Section 57 severs: legal set remains a contract; illegal set is void.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should a Section 57 problem be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Separate legal and illegal sets. II. Enforce legal set as contract. III. Treat illegal set as void. IV. Conclude.

examTips: State the severance of legal and illegal sets.
